jobs.title: Head of Finance
jobs.description:
ABOUT WARP

Warp is the AI-native Employee Management Platform for ambitious companies. HRIS, payroll, benefits, IT, tax compliance, and more, all built from scratch on one AI-native platform.

Every company runs on its people, and the software that manages them is some of the oldest in the enterprise. Incumbents like ADP and Workday built their businesses on complexity and large ops teams. Warp is built for AI to be the primary operator. Every advance in LLM capability widens our lead.

We process $X billion in annual payments for high-growth companies across all 50 US states + globally.

We've raised $85M from Battery Ventures, Sapphire Ventures, Peak XV, Sound Ventures (Ashton Kutcher), and Y Combinator, alongside operators including Tobi Lütke (Shopify), Claire Hughes Johnson (Stripe), and the founders of Dropbox and Replit. Our team comes from MIT, Ramp, Brex, Google, Gusto, Rippling, and more.

We hire people who ship constantly, own outcomes, and care about craft. If you want to automate an entire category of work that every company depends on, this is the place.


ABOUT THE ROLE 

We're hiring a Head of Finance to build and own the financial engine of a company scaling revenue to $50M+. You'll be the CEO's primary partner on strategic finance: the operating model, board and investor reporting, unit economics, and the capital decisions that come with an $85M-raised, money-moving business. You'll start hands-on and build the team beneath you over time.



What you'll do

 - Own the financial model and forecast. Turn the charter's revenue trajectory into a plan the company runs against and a model the board trusts.

 - Run board and investor reporting: monthly metrics, quarterly board materials, and the financial narrative behind both.

 - Own unit economics and pricing analysis. ARPU, gross margin, payback, and the economics of new lines like benefits brokerage and in-house payroll rails.

 - Partner on capital allocation. Where the Series B goes, how we think about burn and runway, and the return on big bets like replacing our money-movement vendor.

 - Build the finance function. Hire and lead the controller and ops side, and own relationships with our wealth, banking, and accounting partners and our auditors.

 - Be the financial backbone of the next fundraise when it comes.



What we're looking for:

 - 5+ years in finance, including ownership of FP&A and board reporting at a high-growth startup.

 - Deep FP&A and strategic finance ability. You can build a model yourself from scratch and defend all assumptions to a board.

 - You are fluent in SaaS metrics, and ideally fintech or payments economics: float, money movement, and multi-product ARPU.

 - You've partnered directly with a founder or CEO to make decisions and build.

 - You can be hands-on now, and a team-builder later. No task is beneath our leadership at this stage.



Nice to Have:

 - Experience in the payroll, payments, insurance space, or another regulated money-moving business.

 - You've helped run a priced fundraise.


BENEFITS AT WARP: 

 - 100% Health Coverage: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your dependents.

 - 401(k) Matching: Start investing in your future from day one.

 - Flexible PTO: We offer uncapped flexible PTO, meaning you’re trusted to take the time you need to recharge while balancing your responsibilities and team commitments.

 - Commuter Benefits: Pre-tax commuter benefits for your daily trip to our NYC office.

 - Catered Lunch Daily: Great food, every day, on us. No meal prep, no decision fatigue.

 - Quarterly Offsites: Beautiful locations to connect as a team. Past locations include Spain, Catskills, and San Francisco.

Warp is based in New York City, and most of our team works together in-office 5x per week. Please refer to the top of this page for this position's hiring location and working model.

About the Role

Channel partnerships are one of Warp's biggest growth opportunities.

We're looking for our first Channel Partnerships Lead hire to build this function from the ground up. You'll create a repeatable partner motion that generates qualified pipeline through trusted advisors who already serve our ideal customers. Think accounting firms, benefits brokerages, fractional HR leaders, executive advisors, and other firms helping founders build and operate their companies.

In this role, you'll own the entire channel motion, from identifying the right partner segments and developing the playbook to sourcing new partners, launching relationships, generating revenue, and building the systems that make the channel scalable.

You'll work directly with company leadership and have significant ownership over one of Warp's highest-leverage growth initiatives. As the channel grows, so will your scope.

What You’ll Do

 - Build Warp's partner ecosystem across accounting firms, benefits brokerages, fractional HR firms, executive advisors, and other trusted advisors.

 - Source, negotiate, and launch strategic partnerships that generate qualified pipeline and revenue.

 - Own partner-sourced pipeline and work closely with Sales to convert referrals into customers.

 - Build strong, long-term relationships with partner leaders and create repeatable referral motions.

 - Develop the playbooks, onboarding, enablement, and reporting that allow the channel to scale.

 - Help build one of Warp's highest-leverage growth channels from the ground up.

What You Need

 -  5+ years of experience in Partnerships, Business Development, Sales, or another GTM role

 - At least 3 years building or managing strategic partnerships

 - Experience creating or meaningfully scaling a partner or channel program

 - Strong communication and executive relationship-building skills

 - High agency - you identify problems and solve them without waiting for direction

We hire people who ship constantly, own outcomes, and care about craft. If you want to automate an entire category of work that every company depends on, this is the place.


ABOUT THE ROLE


Warp has grown from 10 to 70 people in the past year, and the systems that work for a small startup don't work for long at this scale. We're looking for an IT & Security Compliance Manager to build and own the infrastructure that keeps Warp secure, compliant, and operational as we continue to grow.

You'll own how Warp employees access the tools and systems they need to do their jobs, how devices are provisioned and secured, how we meet our compliance obligations, and how we protect our offices and physical infrastructure. That includes identity and access management, endpoint management, employee onboarding and offboarding, SOC 1, SOC 2, HIPAA, vendor security, and physical security.

This role also has a unique opportunity to directly influence what we build for our customers. IT is a growing part of the Warp product, and you'll be both the person operating these systems internally and an expert helping us rethink how they should work. You'll work closely with product and engineering to inform our IT product suite across identity and access, device management, employee lifecycle, and more. You'll dogfood what we build, identify where existing IT tools and workflows fall short, and help us build a better version for our customers.

This is a hands-on role. You'll implement systems yourself, automate processes that shouldn't be manual, work directly with engineering and operations, and own projects from identifying the problem through implementation. We're looking for someone who can operate the systems we need today while designing them for a company many times our current size.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own identity and access management for Warp employees, including implementing and managing Okta, SSO, MFA, role-based access, and application provisioning

 - Own the IT side of the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, device provisioning, access changes, and asset management

 - Own and continuously improve our SOC 1, SOC 2, HIPAA, and other security and compliance programs

 - Translate compliance requirements into practical technical and operational controls rather than treating compliance as a point-in-time audit exercise

 - Automate access reviews, evidence collection, employee provisioning, and other repetitive security and IT workflows

 - Manage vendor security and third-party risk, including security reviews and ongoing vendor access

 - Own office and physical security, including badge access, visitor management, and related policies and systems

 - Partner with engineering on security initiatives that cross corporate and product infrastructure

 - Work closely with product and engineering to inform Warp's IT product suite, bringing firsthand experience from operating these systems internally

 - Dogfood Warp's IT products and help identify where we can automate or fundamentally improve the work IT teams do today


YOU'LL BE GOOD FOR THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Like building systems more than administering processes

 - Are equally comfortable configuring Okta, working through an auditor request, investigating an access issue, and writing the policy that prevents it from recurring

 - Have strong opinions about how modern IT should work and are excited to help turn those opinions into product

 - Understand that good security should make the right thing easy rather than create unnecessary bureaucracy

 - Can distinguish between a meaningful security control and compliance theater

 - Automate repetitive work instead of accepting it as part of the job

 - Are comfortable owning ambiguous problems without waiting for someone to give you a playbook

 - Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical teams

 - Want to build the IT and security foundation for a company growing quickly rather than inherit a mature enterprise program


WHAT YOU NEED

 - Experience owning IT, corporate security, security compliance, or a combination of these functions at a growing technology company

 - Hands-on experience implementing or administering identity and access management systems such as Okta

 - Experience with SSO, MFA, SCIM, device management, endpoint security, and SaaS administration

 - Experience running SOC 2 or similar compliance programs and working directly with auditors

 - Familiarity with SOC 1, HIPAA, and security frameworks and controls relevant to a company handling sensitive customer and employee data

 - Experience managing employee onboarding and offboarding from an IT and access perspective

 - Strong technical judgment and the ability to understand how systems interact, not just administer individual tools

 - High agency. You figure things out.

 - Willingness to work from our NYC office five days a week


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience building the IT or security function at a startup during a period of rapid headcount growth

 - Experience with scripting, APIs, or workflow automation

 - Experience with physical and office security

 - Experience with vendor risk management and customer security reviews

 - Experience supporting enterprise customers and the security requirements that come with them


BENEFITS AT WARP: 

 - 100% Health Coverage: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your dependents.

 - 401(k) Matching: Start investing in your future from day one.

 - Flexible PTO: We offer uncapped flexible PTO, meaning you’re trusted to take the time you need to recharge while balancing your responsibilities and team commitments.

 - Commuter Benefits: Pre-tax commuter benefits for your daily trip to our NYC office.

 - Catered Lunch Daily: Great food, every day, on us. No meal prep, no decision fatigue.
